question.question: If Charismatic must Recruit but only one Eyrie warrior remains in supply, can placing that one fulfill the Decree?

expected.expected_answer: No. Charismatic requires two; inability fully complete causes immediate turmoil despite maximum-possible piece placement.

source_passages.section: Actions — Eyrie Dynasties (7), incomplete Decree action and Charismatic Recruit
source_passages.quotation: If a prompted placement runs short, place the maximum possible first, as clarified in **FAQ & Rulings**. If the required action cannot be completed fully for any reason (including warrior/building supply), immediately enter **Turmoil**; do not skip that card or continue other Decree columns. With Charismatic and only one warrior available, place that one, then enter Turmoil: one does not fulfill the required two.

source_passages.section: FAQ & Rulings — Charismatic and a supply shortage
source_passages.quotation: - **Charismatic and a supply shortage:** When a legal Decree Recruit requires two warriors but only one remains in supply, place that warrior first. Then enter Turmoil because the required two were not placed. Maximum-possible placement does not fulfill an incomplete Decree action. (FAQ under 7.7 and 7.8.2; Law 1.5.4.)

answer.ruling: No. If Charismatic's Decree Recruit requires two warriors but only one remains, place that warrior first and then enter Turmoil. Maximum placement does not fulfill the incomplete two-warrior Decree action.
